pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.1.1: tena samayena buddho bhagavā rājagahe viharati veḷuvane kalandakanivāpe.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.1.2: tena kho pana samayena āyasmatā dabbena mallaputtena jātiyā sattavassena arahattaṃ sacchikataṃ hoti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.1.3: yaṃ kiñci sāvakena pattabbaṃ, sabbaṃ tena anuppattaṃ hoti,
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.1.4: natthi cassa kiñci uttari karaṇīyaṃ, katassa vā paticayo.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.1.5: atha kho āyasmato dabbassa mallaputtassa rahogatassa paṭisallīnassa evaṃ cetaso parivitakko udapādi:
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.1.7: yaṃ kiñci sāvakena pattabbaṃ sabbaṃ mayā anuppattaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.1.8: natthi ca me kiñci uttari karaṇīyaṃ, katassa vā paticayo.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.1.9: kinnu kho ahaṃ saṅghassa veyyāvaccaṃ kareyya’nti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.1.10: atha kho āyasmato dabbassa mallaputtassa etadahosi:
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.1.11: “yannūnāhaṃ saṅghassa senāsanañca paññapeyyaṃ bhattāni ca uddiseyya”nti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.2.1: atha kho āyasmā dabbo mallaputto sāyanhasamayaṃ paṭisallānā vuṭṭhito yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.2.2: ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā dabbo mallaputto bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.2.3: “idha mayhaṃ bhante rahogatassa patisallīnassa evaṃ cetaso parivitakko udapādi. mayā kho jātiyā sattavassena arahattaṃ sacchikataṃ. yaṃ kiñci sāvakena pattabbaṃ sabbaṃ mayā anupattaṃ, natthi ca me kiñci uttari karaṇīyaṃ. katassa vā paticayo, kiṃ nu kho ahaṃ saṅghassa veyyāvaccaṃ kareyya”nti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.2.5: “yannūnāhaṃ saṅghassa senāsanañca paññapeyyaṃ, bhattāni ca uddiseyyanti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.2.6: “icchāmahaṃ bhante saṅghassa senāsanañca paññāpetuṃ bhattāni ca uddisitu”nti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.2.8: tena hi tvaṃ dabba, saṅghassa senāsanañca paññapehi, bhattāni ca uddisā”ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.2.9: “evaṃ bhante”ti kho āyasmā dabbo mallaputto bhagavato paccassosi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.3.1: atha kho bhagavā etasmiṃ nidāne etasmiṃ pakaraṇe dhammiṃ kathaṃ katvā bhikkhū āmantesi:
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.3.2: “tena hi bhikkhave saṅgho dabbaṃ mallaputtaṃ senāsanapaññāpakañca bhattuddesakañca sammannatu.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.3.5: yācitvā vyattena bhikkhunā paṭibalena saṅgho ñāpetabbo: –
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.3.7: yadi saṅghassa pattakallaṃ saṅgho āyasmantaṃ dabbaṃ mallaputtaṃ senāsanapaññāpakañca bhattuddesakañca sammanneyya,
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.3.10: saṅgho āyasmantaṃ dabbaṃ mallaputtaṃ senāsanapaññāpakañca bhattuddesakañca sammannati.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.3.11: yassāyasmato khamati āyasmato dabbassa mallaputtassa senāsanapaññāpakassa ca bhattuddesakassa ca sammuti, so tuṇhassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.3.13: sammato saṅghena āyasmā dabbo mallaputto senāsanapaññāpako ca bhattuddesako ca.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.4.1: sammato ca panāyasmā dabbo mallaputto sabhāgānaṃ sabhāgānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ ekajjhaṃ senāsanaṃ paññāpeti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.4.2: ye te bhikkhū suttantikā tesaṃ ekajjhaṃ senāsanaṃ paññāpeti,
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.4.4: ye te bhikkhū vinayadharā tesaṃ ekajjhaṃ senāsanaṃ paññāpeti,
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.4.6: ye te bhikkhū dhammakathikā tesaṃ ekajjhā senāsanaṃ paññāpeti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.4.8: ye te bhikkhū jhāyino tesaṃ ekajjhaṃ senāsanaṃ paññāpeti,
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.4.10: ye te bhikkhū tiracchānakathikā kāyadaḍḍhibahulā viharanti, tesampi ekajjhaṃ senāsanaṃ paññāpeti,
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.4.12: yepi te bhikkhū vikāle āgacchanti tesampi tejodhātuṃ samāpajjitvā teneva ālokena senāsanaṃ paññāpeti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.4.15: te āyasmantaṃ dabbaṃ mallaputtaṃ upasaṅkamitvā evaṃ vadanti:
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.4.17: te āyasmā dabbo mallaputto evaṃ vadeti:
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.4.20: “amhākaṃ āvuso, dabba, gijjhakūṭe pabbate senāsanaṃ paññāpehi,
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.4.22: amhākaṃ āvuso isigilipasse kāḷasilāyaṃ senāsanaṃ paññapehi,
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.4.23: amhākaṃ āvuso vebhārapasse sattapaṇṇiguhāyaṃ senāsanaṃ paññāpehi,
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.4.24: amhākaṃ āvuso sītavane sappasoṇḍikapabbhāre senāsanaṃ paññāpehi,
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.4.30: amhākaṃ āvuso maddakucchismiṃ migadāye senāsanaṃ paññapehī”ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.4.31: tesaṃ āyasmā dabbo mallaputto tejodhātuṃ samāpajjitvā aṅguliyā jalamānāya purato purato gacchati.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.4.32: tepi teneva ālokena āyasmato dabbassa mallaputtassa piṭṭhito piṭṭhito gacchanti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.4.33: tesaṃ āyasmā dabbo mallaputto evaṃ senāsanaṃ paññāpeti:
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.4.34: “ayaṃ mañco, idaṃ pīṭhaṃ, ayaṃ bhisi, idaṃ bimbohanaṃ, idaṃ vaccaṭṭhānaṃ, idaṃ passāvaṭṭhānaṃ, idaṃ pānīyaṃ, idaṃ paribhojanīyaṃ, ayaṃ kattaradaṇḍo,
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.4.35: idaṃ saṅghassa katikasaṇṭhānaṃ, imaṃ kālaṃ pavisitabbaṃ, imaṃ kālaṃ nikkhamitabba”nti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.4.36: tesaṃ āyasmā dabbo mallaputto evaṃ senāsanaṃ paññāpetvā punadeva veḷuvanaṃ paccāgacchati.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.5.1: tena kho pana samayena mettiyabhummajakā bhikkhū navakā ceva honti appapuññā ca,
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.5.2: yāni saṅghassa lāmakāni senāsanāni, tāni tesaṃ pāpuṇanti lāmakāni ca bhattāni.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.5.3: tena kho pana samayena rājagahe manussā icchanti therānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ abhisaṅkhārikaṃ piṇḍapātaṃ dātuṃ sappimpi telampi uttaribhaṅgampi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.5.4: mettiyabhummajakānaṃ pana bhikkhūnaṃ pākatikaṃ denti yathārandhaṃ kaṇājakaṃ bilaṅgadutiyaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.5.5: te pacchābhattaṃ piṇḍapātapaṭikkantā there bhikkhū pucchanti:
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.5.6: tumhākaṃ āvuso bhattagge kiṃ ahosi, tumhākaṃ kiṃ ahosī”ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.5.8: “amhākaṃ āvuso sappi ahosi telaṃ ahosi uttaribhaṅgaṃ ahosī”ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.5.10: “amhākaṃ āvuso na kiñci ahosi pākatikaṃ yathārandhaṃ kaṇājakaṃ bilaṅgadutiya”nti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.6.1: tena kho pana samayena kalyāṇabhattiko gahapati saṅghassa catukkabhattaṃ deti niccabhattaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.6.3: aññe odanena pucchanti, aññe sūpena pucchanti, aññe telena pucchanti, aññe uttaribhaṅgena pucchanti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.6.4: tena kho pana samayena kalyāṇabhattikassa gahapatino bhattaṃ svātanāya mettiyabhummajakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ uddiṭṭhaṃ hoti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.6.5: atha kho kalyāṇabhattiko gahapati ārāmaṃ agamāsi kenacideva karaṇīyena.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.6.6: so yenāyasmā dabbo mallaputto tenupasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ dabbaṃ mallaputtaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.6.7: ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho kalyāṇabhattikaṃ gahapatiṃ āyasmā dabbo mallaputto dhammiyā kathāya sandassesi samādapesi samuttejesi sampahaṃsesi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.6.8: atha kho kalyāṇabhattiko gahapati āyasmatā dabbena mallaputtena dhammiyā kathāya sandassito samādapito samuttejito sampahaṃsito āyasmantaṃ dabbaṃ mallaputtaṃ etadavoca:
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.6.9: “kassa bhante amhākaṃ ghare svātanāya bhattaṃ uddiṭṭha”nti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.6.11: atha kho kalyāṇabhattiko gahapati anattamano ahosi
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.6.12: “kathaṃ hi nāma pāpabhikkhū amhākaṃ ghare bhuñjissantī”ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.6.14: “ye je sve bhattikā āgacchanti te koṭṭhake āsanaṃ paññāpetvā kaṇājakena bilaṅgadutiyena parivisā”ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.6.15: “evaṃ ayyā”ti kho sā dāsī kalyāṇabhattikassa gahapatino paccassosi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.7.2: “hiyyo kho āvuso amhākaṃ kalyāṇabhattikassa gahapatino bhattaṃ uddiṭṭhaṃ,
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.7.3: sve amhe kalyāṇabhattiko gahapati saputtadāro upatiṭṭhitvā parivisissati.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.7.4: aññe odanena pucchissanti, aññe sūpena pucchissanti, aññe telena pucchissanti, aññe uttaribhaṅgena pucchissantī”ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.7.5: te teneva somanassena na cittarūpaṃ rattiyā supiṃsu.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.7.6: atha kho mettiyabhummajakā bhikkhū pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaraṃ ādāya yena kalyāṇabhattikassa gahapatino nivesanaṃ tenupasaṅkamiṃsu.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.7.7: addasā kho sā dāsī mettiyabhummajake bhikkhū dūratova āgacchante, disvāna koṭṭhake āsanaṃ paññapetvā mettiyabhummajake bhikkhū etadavoca:
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.7.10: “nissaṃsayaṃ kho na tāva bhattaṃ siddhaṃ bhavissati. yāva mayaṃ koṭṭhake nisīdāpiyeyyamā”ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.7.11: atha kho sā dāsī kaṇājakena bilaṅgadutiyena upagacchi:
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.7.15: apicāhaṃ hiyyova āṇattā: ‘ye je sve bhattikā āgacchanti, te koṭṭhake āsanaṃ paññāpetvā kaṇājakena bilaṅgadutiyena parivisā’ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.7.18: “hiyyo kho āvuso kalyāṇabhattiko gahapati ārāmaṃ agamāsi, dabbassa mallaputtassa santike.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.7.19: nissaṃsayaṃ kho mayaṃ dabbena mallaputtena gahapatino paribhinnā”ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.7.20: te teneva domanassena na cittarūpaṃ bhuñjiṃsu.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.7.21: atha kho mettiyabhummajakā bhikkhū pacchābhattaṃ piṇḍapātappaṭikkantā ārāmaṃ gantvā pattacīvaraṃ paṭisāmetvā bahārāmakoṭṭhake saṅghāṭipallatthikāya nisīdiṃsu tuṇhībhūtā maṅkubhūtā pattakkhandhā adhomukhā pajjhāyantā appaṭibhānā.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.8.1: atha kho mettiyā bhikkhunī yena mettiyabhummajakā bhikkhū tenupasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā mettiyabhummajake bhikkhū etadavoca:
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.8.5: tatiyampi kho mettiyā bhikkhunī mettiyabhummajake bhikkhū etadavoca:
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.8.10: tathā hi pana tvaṃ bhagini, amhe dabbena mallaputtena viheṭhiyamāne ajjhupekkhasī’ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.8.12: ‘sace kho tvaṃ bhagini iccheyyāsi ajjeva bhagavā dabbaṃ mallaputtaṃ nāsāpeyyā’ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.8.13: kyāhaṃ ayyā karomi. kiṃ mayā sakkā kātunti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.8.14: ehi tvaṃ bhagini, yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkama, upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ evaṃ vadehi:
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.8.16: yāyaṃ bhante disā abhayā anītikā anupaddavā, sāyaṃ disā sabhayā saītikā saupaddavā,
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.8.20: evaṃ ayyāti kho mettiyā bhikkhunī mettiyabhummajakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ paṭissutvā yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhāsi,
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.8.21: ekamantaṃ ṭhitā kho mettiyā bhikkhunī bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.8.23: yāyaṃ bhante disā abhayā anītikā anupaddavā, sāyaṃ disā sabhayā saītikā saupaddavā,
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.9.1: atha kho bhagavā etasmiṃ nidāne etasmiṃ pakaraṇe bhikkhusaṅghaṃ sannipātāpetvā āyasmantaṃ dabbaṃ mallaputtaṃ paṭipucchi:
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.9.2: ‘sarasi tvaṃ dabba evarūpaṃ kattā yathāyaṃ bhikkhunī āhā,ti
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.9.5: tatiyampi kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ dabbaṃ mallaputtaṃ etadavoca:
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.9.6: “sarasi tvaṃ dabba evarūpaṃ kattā yathāyaṃ bhikkhunī āhā”ti
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.9.11: “yato ahaṃ bhante jāto nābhijānāmi supinantenapi methunaṃ dhammaṃ patisevitā, pageva jāgaro”ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.9.15: idaṃ vatvā bhagavā uṭṭhāyāsanā vihāraṃ pāvisi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.9.16: atha kho te bhikkhū mettiyaṃ bhikkhuniṃ nāsesuṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.9.17: atha kho mettiyabhummajakā bhikkhū te bhikkhū etadavocuṃ:
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.9.20: amhehi sā ussāhitā kupitehi anattamanehi cāvanādhippāyehī”ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.9.21: “kiṃ pana tumhe āvuso āyasmantaṃ dabbaṃ mallaputtaṃ amūlakena pārājikena dhammena anuddhaṃsethā”ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.9.23: ye te bhikkhū appicchā te ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.9.24: “kathaṃ hi nāma mettiyabhummajakā bhikkhū āyasmantaṃ dabbaṃ mallaputtaṃ amūlakena pārājikena dhammena anuddhaṃsessantī”ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.9.25: atha kho te bhikkhū bhagavato etamatthaṃ ārocesuṃ …pe…
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.9.26: “saccaṃ kira tumhe bhikkhave dabbaṃ mallaputtaṃ amūlakena pārājikena dhammena anuddhaṃsethā”ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.9.29: “kathaṃ hi nāma tumhe moghapurisā dabbaṃ mallaputtaṃ amūlakena pārājikena dhammena anuddhaṃsessatha.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.9.31: evañca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha:
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.9.32.1: “yo pana bhikkhu bhikkhuṃ duṭṭho doso appatīto amūlakena pārājikena dhammena anuddhaṃseyya appevanāma naṃ imamhā brahmacariyā cāveyyanti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.9.33: tato aparena samayena samanuggātiyamāno vā asamanuggātiyamāno vā amūlakañceva taṃ adhikaraṇaṃ hoti bhikkhu ca dosaṃ patiṭṭhāti, saṅghādiseso”ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:2.10: tena ca kopena tena ca dosena tāya ca anattamanatāya tāya ca anabhiraddhiyā appatīto hoti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:2.18: bhikkhubhāvā cāveyyaṃ, samaṇadhammā cāveyyaṃ sīlakkhandhā cāveyyaṃ tapoguṇā cāveyyaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:2.20: yasmiṃ khaṇe anuddhaṃsito hoti taṃ khaṇaṃ taṃ layaṃ taṃ muhuttaṃ vītivatte.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:2.22: yena vatthunā anuddhaṃsito hoti tasmiṃ vatthusmiṃ samanuggāhīyamāno.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:2.26: cattāri adhikaraṇāni vivādādhikaraṇaṃ anuvādādhikaraṇaṃ āpattādhikaraṇaṃ kiccādhikaraṇaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:2.28: tucchakaṃ mayā bhaṇitaṃ, musā mayā bhaṇitaṃ, abhūtaṃ mayā bhaṇitaṃ, ajānantena mayā bhaṇitaṃ.

pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:3.1.4: natthi tayā saddhiṃ uposatho vā pavāraṇā vā saṅghakammaṃ vā”ti,
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:3.1.8: tañce codeti: “suto mayā pārājikaṃ dhammaṃ ajjhāpannosi,
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:3.1.10: natthi tayā saddhiṃ uposatho vā pavāraṇā vā saṅghakammaṃ vā”ti,
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:3.1.14: tañce codeti: ‘parisaṅkito mayā pārājikaṃ dhammaṃ ajjhāpannosi,
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:3.1.16: natthi tayā saddhiṃ uposatho vā pavāraṇā vā saṅghakammaṃ vā”ti,
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:3.2.2: tañce, codeti: “diṭṭho mayā suto ca pārājikaṃ dhammaṃ ajjhāpannosi

pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:3.2.6: tañce codeti: “diṭṭho mayā parisaṅkito ca pārājikaṃ dhammaṃ ajjhāpannosi,
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:3.2.10: tañce codeti: “diṭṭho mayā suto ca parisaṅkito ca pārājikaṃ dhammaṃ ajjhāpannosi
